240: // FB-002: ladders and ropes are drawn because the generated ladder prop renders as a 12-pixel-wide 3D ladder
241: // seen at an angle, which cannot be read in a flat side view. Delete this when the library has a 2D ladder.
242: private drawClimbable(c: Climbable) {
243:     const top = c.top * TILE;
244:     const bottom = (c.bottom + 1) * TILE;
245:     const x = c.col * TILE + TILE / 2;
246:     const g = this.add.graphics().setDepth(8);
247:     const wood = c.rope ? 0x9a7440 : 0xc9a25e;
248:     const shade = c.rope ? 0x6a4c26 : 0x8a6a3c;
249:     if (c.rope) {
250:       g.lineStyle(3, wood, 1).lineBetween(x, top, x, bottom);
251:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillCircle(x, bottom - 4, 4);
252:       return;
253:     }
254:     // Two rails and the rungs between them.
255:     for (const dx of [-8, 8]) {
256:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1.5, top, 3, bottom - top);
257:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1, top, 2, bottom - top);
258:     }
259:     for (let y = top + 8; y < bottom - 2; y += 11) {
260:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x - 10, y, 20, 4);
261:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x - 9, y + 1, 18, 2);
262:     }
263:   }

476:   private updateCreatures(dt: number) {
477:     for (const c of this.creatures) {
478:       if (c.dead || c.spent) continue;
479:       const m = c.mover;
480:       m.vx = c.dir * (c.kind === 'skull' ? 46 : 42);
481:       if (c.kind === 'skull') {
482:         // The skull hops at Joe when he comes into reach.
483:         const sameRow = Math.abs((this.joe.mover.y - 22 - m.y) / TILE) < 1.6;
484:         if (sameRow && Math.abs(this.joe.mover.x - m.x) < TILE * 3 && m.onGround) m.vy = -430;
485:       }
486:       m.step(dt, this.world, GRAVITY);
487:       if (m.hitWall || !m.hasFloorAhead(this.world, c.dir)) c.dir *= -1;
488:       this.playCreature(c.view, c.kind, c.dir > 0 ? 'E' : 'W');
489:       c.view.setPosition(Math.round(m.x), Math.round(m.y - m.h));
490:       if (c.kind === 'skull') c.view.rotation = Math.sin(this.time.now / 90) * 0.22;
491: 
492:       // Contact: the sword takes one of them, otherwise Joe is caught.
493:       const near = Math.abs(m.x - this.joe.mover.x) < (m.w + 20) / 2 && Math.abs(m.y - this.joe.mover.y) < 34;
494:       if (near && !this.joe.dead) {
495:         if (state.hasSword) {
496:           c.dead = true;
497:           state.hasSword = false;
498:           state.pack = state.pack.filter((p) => p !== 'sword');
499:           this.syncHud();
500:           sfx.break();
501:           this.tweens.add({ targets: c.view, alpha: 0, y: c.view.y + 16, duration: 400, onComplete: () => c.view.destroy() });
502:         } else {
503:           // In the early levels a creature does not come back to the same room after it catches Joe.
504:           if (state.level <= 2) c.spent = true;
505:           this.joe.kill();
506:         }
507:       }
508:     }
509:   }

590:   private updateDoors() {
591:     if (this.joe.dead || this.busy) return;
592:     const jx = this.joe.mover.x;
593:     const jTop = this.joe.mover.y - this.joe.mover.h;

### Keep a game's assets as sprites: `ssg sprite apply`

`ssg export` renders an anonymous batch into a folder: nothing shows up in the app's Projects/Sprites (it prints a
`tip:` line saying so). A game's build script should declare its sprites instead. `ssg sprite apply` creates or
updates each one **by name** in a project, so the sprites appear in the app, stay editable there, and a re-run with
the same file changes nothing (only entries that changed become outdated, and only outdated sprites render):

```jsonc

  "view": "iso8", "tile": "64x32", "metresPerTile": 1, "format": "phaser3", "fps": 10,
  "sprites": [

      "anim": ["idle", "walk", "shoot", "throw"], "maxSeconds": 2, "uniform": true, "layers": ["normal"],
      "with": ["POLYGON_War/SM_Wep_American_Rifle_01", "POLYGON_War/SM_Char_Attach_American_Helmet_01"] },

    { "name": "wire", "asset": "POLYGON_War/SM_Prop_Wire_01", "template": "still", "facings": 2 },
    { "name": "crate", "asset": "POLYGON_War/SM_Prop_Crate_02", "template": "still", "dirs": "4d", "uniform": false }

}
```
